blocks.text: The whole site is **two pages and one tool**. The hub page lists everything; the template makes every other page; the tool keeps them in step.

items.title: hub.json
items.text: The single source of truth for the directory and every index list.

items.title: hub.py
items.text: Builds the hub and every page, and serves the visual editor.

items.title: index.html
items.text: The hub page: directory, index lists, living background.

items.title: template.html
items.text: The one template every other page is made from.

blocks.text:
1. `hub.json` says what exists and in what order.
2. The tool writes only between marked regions, so everything else in your files is yours.
3. A page is the template plus its content, so changing the template restyles every page.
